description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) representing a leave status with an associated length in days for the OrangeHRM leave management plugin.

classes.name: LeaveStatusWithLengthDays
classes.description: A DTO class encapsulating leave status information, including an ID, name, and length in days, with methods for accessing and modifying these properties.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of LeaveStatusWithLengthDays with specified ID, name, and optional length in days.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the leave status.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the leave status.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the leave status.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the leave status.

methods.name: getLengthDays
methods.description: Returns the length in days associated with the leave status.

methods.name: setLengthDays
methods.description: Sets the length in days for the leave status.

methods.name: addToLengthDays
methods.description: Adds a specified number of days to the current length in days.
